title: A Temporal Analysis of Earnings Surprises: Profits versus Losses
sources_checked: output/samples/records/W1987881672.json (hash matched task.json): original sample is 176,519 firm-quarter observations from I/B/E/S U.S. Detail for 1984–1999; paper pages 5–6.
output/models/records/W1987881672.json (hash matched task.json): nine distinct Table 1 annual regressions, each with 16 original annual observations and panel/outcome mapping on p. 10.
output/reproductions/packages/W1987881672/attempt_02/outcome.json (hash matched task.json): accepted predecessor status executed, all nine assigned fits completed.

Accepted predecessor construction and estimator: output/reproductions/packages/W1987881672/attempt_02/build.sas, stata.ipynb, submission.json; this job’s work/build.sas and work/stata.ipynb are the reviewed, extended working copies.

PROC CONTENTS source catalog, lines 105874–105948: current local IBES.DET_EPSUS catalog entry, 34,540,574 observations, 27 variables, created 2026-06-12 and last modified/reloaded 2026-07-25; date and value field types/formats checked.

${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/ibes/det_epsus.sas7bdat: exact read-only source named in the accepted construction and submission contract; current controller run recorded its size/mtime and used it for the pooled build. No vendor release timestamp is recorded locally.

Accepted predecessor data/ibes_surprises/reg.dta, metadata-only: 16 rows and 14 columns; fiscal_year is int16 and annual outcomes are numeric doubles. No observation values were read in this metadata check.

Current controller SAS aggregate output work/runtime/20261118T053950672489Z/build.lst: the bounded FPEDATS window contains all 21 annual outcome rows; common-USD firm-quarter counts cover original years 1984–1999 (190006) and added years 2000–2004 (81629).

Current controller Stata logs work/runtime/20261118T053950672489Z/cell_*.log and fresh aggregate CSVs work/tables/*.csv: all nine model cells succeeded, with computed e(sample) markers of 16 original + 5 added annual observations through 2004.
changes: Rebuilt the annual handoff jointly from current local IBES.DET_EPSUS for FPEDATS 1984-01-01 inclusive through 2005-01-01 exclusive; the annual grid now runs 1984–2004. No old generated datasets or tables were input to the replay.
Kept the existing U.S./EPS/quarter-period, availability, strictly pre-report, latest-forecast/tie, and common-USD screens; retained all nine original annual outcomes and outcome denominators.

Kept the original `regress outcome fiscal_year` model, constant, OLS estimator, and conventional standard errors. Added computed original/added e(sample) counts and last contributing fiscal year to each selected Stata cell.

The relocated Stata working copy resolves `adopath` to the repository’s published `output/reproductions/resources/ado` directory from this job’s work directory; this supports the unchanged esttab output route.
limitations: The fresh pooled construction reproduces 190,006 common-USD firm-quarter observations for 1984–1999 versus the paper’s 176,519 (+13,487; +7.64%). This predecessor-era population difference remains unexplained; the published count was not used as a target.
The source has no separate fiscal-year label; year(FPEDATS) remains the operational proxy for the paper’s fiscal year representing each firm-quarter.

The local I/B/E/S Detail file is a later vintage. Its reload dates are local catalog metadata, not a vendor release/version identifier; contemporaneous values, historical revisions, and split-adjustment precision cannot be recovered.

The paper reports univariate trend regressions but does not name the estimator or covariance method. The accepted OLS-with-constant, conventional-SE implementation remains a best-effort assumption; Stata reports signed t-statistics and two-sided p-values.

The accepted construction keeps only USD report-currency rows with USD actual-file currency. The predecessor audit excluded 47 selected USD-report/CAD-actual records after forecast selection; no conversion source was assigned. CURRFL is treated as received-estimate currency, not stored VALUE currency.

The accepted construction uses ANNDATS_ACT for the report-date screen and the 2009 guide described a convention change before January 1999. The current aggregate candidate bounds show ANNDATS_ACT through 2010-08-11 even though FPEDATS ends 2004-12-31; observation year remains year(FPEDATS), so these later report dates are not treated as 2010 sample years.

The predecessor 1984–1999 diagnostics reported 112 selected observations with ANNDATS_ACT before FPEDATS, 112 more than one year after FPEDATS (three more than five years), and a maximum forecast age of 4,158 days. The extension retained the accepted no-age-cap/no-period-gap-filter design.
The accepted design treats REVDATS as a forecast-confirmation date and uses it only descriptively; the source does not identify a historical release/vintage snapshot.

In the pooled candidate key audit, no TICKER×FPEDATS keys had multiple report dates or multiple actual values; 229 keys had multiple report currencies. Latest-forecast selection and inherited currency eligibility/tie rules were preserved.
